about_the_game:
Residue Of The Lost

"Some souls aren't lost... they're just left behind."

Residue Of The Lost is a psychological horror experience set within the confines of a single house.

🩸 Story

The player awakens in the body of a sorcerer who once lived in the distant past, reincarnated into the modern world after death. However, with this rebirth, the sorcerer’s identity has been completely lost. What begins as an ordinary life soon becomes shaken by a dark threat from long ago.

Years ago, during your life as a sorcerer, you placed a powerful curse on a malevolent spirit. When your soul reincarnated, the curse shattered — allowing that spirit to cross into the modern world with you. Until you regain your sorcerer identity, this entity watches you from the shadows, lingering in the walls and dark corners of your home.

Throughout the game, your goal is to uncover your lost past and escape the growing threat of the spirit bound to you.

🔮 Key Features

Gameplay & Narrative Structure

Single location – single threat:
The entire story takes place within one house. This home is both your modern living space and a trap where the shadows of your past echo through every room.

Rediscover your sorcerer identity:
Old books, notes, symbols, and hidden rooms scattered throughout the house slowly reveal who you once were.

Puzzle-driven progression:
To remember your forgotten magic, you must solve environmental puzzles, interpret mystical symbols, and piece together fragmented memories.

One enemy – a personal curse:
There are no other spirits, monsters, or supernatural creatures in this world. Only one malevolent spirit — the very one you once cursed — and its sole purpose is to claim you.

First-person psychological tension:
Every breath, every step, and every shift in the darkness of the house is experienced directly through the player’s eyes.

What the Lost Are Saying

“Scents, whispers, and shadows… one of the rare games that makes you feel fear physically.”

“In this game, it’s not just the souls that get lost—you do too.”

Why This Game?

Unlike traditional horror games filled with countless spirits or creatures, Residue Of The Lost delivers an intense psychological experience built around a deeply personal curse, a single enemy, and a single location. As the player tries to escape the house while uncovering fragments of their forgotten past, the tension grows steadily and becomes impossible to ignore.

If a single footstep echoing through a quiet house is enough to make your heart race, then this game is made for you.

If you're ready…


The soul beneath the ashes awaits you.

Once the magic begins, there is no turning back.

Residue of The Lost – Where the lost never rest.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 or AMD Radeon RX 560
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: A cursed spirit from your past life has slipped into the modern world with your reincarnation. As a sorcerer stripped of all memory, uncover the truth within a single house, reclaim your forgotten powers, and prepare for the confrontation awaiting you. The real fear begins here.
